top_signals.title: France to consider new curfews as restrictions help maintain peace
top_signals.summary: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu says measures will be imposed ‘where the situation warrants’
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: GCash Owner Erases Gains in Debut After Record Philippines IPO
top_signals.summary: Mynt Inc., the operator of the mobile-payments app GCash, closed unchanged in its debut after the biggest-ever initial public offering in the Philippines that the company said will bankroll growth through an expansion of lending and financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Boom de canetas emagrecedoras alimenta mercado ilegal no Brasil
top_signals.summary: Rachel Gamarski fala sobre o comércio clandestino de canetas emagrecedoras, em forte expansão no Brasil. Com produção e edição de Catarina Bacci e Mariana Lumy.  (Source: Bloomberg)
